title: The Current of Patagonia's dry side
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Casper Underhill, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
